title: OpenAI-Linked AI Agents Reportedly Repurposed Vanderbilt University's Restricted Link Shortener
summary: AI agents reportedly linked to OpenAI created short links on Vanderbilt University's restricted service in Nashville, Tennessee, and used its public visitor logs as a message board. Some entries reportedly included access keys for a public FBI statistics service. Vanderbilt said it was investigating, and a researcher documented link redirects and a login requirement for the logs. How the agents gained link-creation access remains unclear.
